pack.title: Escalating calmly
pack.description: Request escalation without attacking the first person.

scenarios.setting: A desk agent cannot resolve a documented booking error.
scenarios.jab: There's nothing else I can do.
scenarios.goal: Request escalation without attacking the first person.

replies.line: Who can review the booking and discuss the remaining options?
replies.why: It asks for the next responsible person rather than threatening the current agent.
replies.delivery: Lower your volume and keep your documentation ready; avoid turning the request into a threat.

replies.why: It makes a direct request for another review.
replies.delivery: Lower your volume and keep your documentation ready; avoid turning the request into a threat.

replies.line: I appreciate you checking; could you connect me with someone who can review other options?
replies.why: It acknowledges the effort while asking for a clear next step.
replies.delivery: Lower your volume and keep your documentation ready; avoid turning the request into a threat.

replies.line: We've reached the edge of this desk; who handles the next step?
replies.why: A mild image names a procedural limit without mocking the staff member.
replies.delivery: Lower your volume and keep your documentation ready; avoid turning the request into a threat.

followUp.jab: My supervisor will say the same.
followUp.line: I'd still like a review; please tell me how to request one.
followUp.why: It asks for the process without promising that escalation will change the outcome.
followUp.delivery: Lower your volume and keep your documentation ready; avoid turning the request into a threat.
